permanentService.name: praxis-code.service
permanentService.reason: Rootless user mapping requires setuid newuidmap/newgidmap; containers independently enable no-new-privileges and drop capabilities.

corrections.issue: Podman 4.9.3 read the explicit storage configuration but selected rootless HOME graphroot/runroot defaults.
corrections.resolution: Pin --root and --runroot on every invocation, assert reported paths before building. The completed base image was imported into the hard-capped store; only the verified dedicated old image copies and transfer archive were removed.

corrections.issue: Existing runc does not support Podman's disabled per-container cgroup mode.
corrections.resolution: Install separate distro crun and pin /usr/bin/crun; preserve existing Docker runtime/service.

corrections.issue: First keep-id image ownership preparation exceeded a 30-second runtime control deadline.
corrections.resolution: Bound create preparation at 120 seconds while keeping command runtime independently bounded. The timed-out job remained interrupted and was never rerun; subsequent acceptance used a new disposable fixture.

corrections.issue: Fixture staging omitted diff and then copied dependency directories with Windows-derived restrictive permissions.
corrections.resolution: Stage complete reviewed dependency, apply traversable read-only permissions after transfer, and verify its import as the dedicated UID before fixture execution.

corrections.issue: Podman's independent container timer reported monitor exit code -1, which is not a valid POSIX process exit code.
corrections.resolution: Preserve the negative monitor code internally, expose an unknown process exit as null, and report timeout inference explicitly as interrupted/timeout_inferred. The actual fixture verifies the container stopped and was not automatically restarted.

limitations: Automated fixture evidence is distinct from an actual iPhone coding session.
Filesystem capacity and effective cgroup files are observed; deliberate disk, memory, and PID exhaustion stress is not claimed.
The corrected bootstrap script is syntax-checked and its changed commands exercised; a second complete package/image bootstrap is not claimed.

earlierFailureResolved.issue: Podman monitor exit -1 was previously reported as a process failure.
earlierFailureResolved.resolution: Normalize the unavailable POSIX exit code to null. Preserve observed stopped state and report interrupted/timeout_inferred explicitly, without claiming a definitively observed cause or rerunning the command.
